nonBlockingIssues.description: Create() uses time.Now().UTC() directly instead of an injected clock. Acceptable in imperative shell but noted per AGENTS.md code smell guidance.
Create() does not ensure base directory exists before running git worktree add. Previous implementation had os.MkdirAll which was removed during refactor.
Remove() has redundant filepath.Abs(path) calls — absPath is computed twice.
shouldCopyFile has duplicated dotfile pattern matching block — dead code.
Double emptiness check in SanitizeBranchName is correct but slightly confusing structure.
CopyFiles symlink handling creates relative symlinks that may be dangling if the target file is excluded by patterns.
shouldCopyFile has redundant dotfile matching block duplicating earlier logic. Same issue as worktree-create-list-remove.
RunHook doc comment says 'own process group' but doesn't set cmd.SysProcAttr with Setpgid. Documentation accuracy issue, not functional bug.

appliedUpdates.description: Added macOS symlink gotcha (/var → /private/var) to environment.md Platform Notes section. Pattern: use filepath.EvalSymlinks() before path comparison.
Added GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 git subprocess pattern and filepath.Walk symlink behavior to environment.md Git Subprocess Patterns section.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify the boundary for clock injection: explicitly state that time.Now() is acceptable in the imperative shell (GitManager, cmd handlers) but not in pure domain functions. The current code smell table is ambiguous — 'time.Now() in core logic' could be misread as prohibiting it in the shell layer too.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: worktree-create-list-remove review: GitManager.Create() uses time.Now() in the imperative shell. Multiple workers may hit this ambiguity. The project AGENTS.md engineering principles section is clearer than the code smell table.
